summary: All four indices closed modestly red in a two-front rotation: high-multiple software was de-rated (APP/HUBS/DDOG/FIG -15% to -20% even on beats) as AI was repriced as a cost and demand threat, while a Hormuz escalation bid crude and drove Smart Money into hard assets, energy and fintech. NDX downgraded to Bearish; VIX -4.24% signalled orderly rotation not panic.
